Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0050 2026-07-17
RETROSPECTIVE — Ownership Became Ambiguous at Shift
Change
Date: 2026-07-17
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Recorder: PERSON-0011, TEAM-0005
What happened At a hydraulics desk change, the incoming coordinator read
the recorder's name as the receiving owner. The outgoing coordinator had
intended it only as the note's author. The resulting calls went to the writer
while the team scope question remained outside the handover conversation.
ISSUE-0112, TASK-0299, and TASK-0800 locate the review folder.
What helped The outgoing desk had retained its dated carry list. Reading the
team entry beside the next action showed what responsibility had actually
been intended. The review discussion separated authorship, paper collection,
and ownership instead of assigning all of them to whoever had written the
clearest note.
What changes Use separate owning-team and receiving-role spaces on the
transfer sheet. Apply receiver echo: the receiver repeats the next coordination
action and its due date, and the sending clerk records that response in the
transfer margin. A signature-like initial or presence at a conversation is
insufficient.
ok
If the receiving role is uncertain, the outgoing desk keeps the next contact and
asks the duty chair to resolve the scope before shift end. The uncertainty must
travel with the action, not disappear into an unlabelled note.
Follow-up PERSON-OO1] will walk through the revised transfer margin with
the roster clerk on 2026-07-20. Keep the original ambiguous note as a teaching
copy beside the corrected layout.
D. Worker 0011
Demo Worker 0011, Demo Team 05
